title: Multi-Panel Storyboard Comic Sheet
description: Tạo một trang storyboard 6 khung hình nối tiếp nhau giữ nguyên nhân vật và phong cách vẽ.
author: Tôi Là Tùng
template:
A professional storyboard layout containing exactly 6 panels arranged in a 2x3 grid, showing a sequence of events. The character is the exact same [Describe Subject e.g., young Vietnamese guy wearing a black hoodie] throughout all panels.
- Panel 1: Close-up of [Subject looking at a laptop screen in shock].
- Panel 2: Medium shot of [Subject writing code furiously with digital neon circuits floating around].
- Panel 3: Wide shot of [Subject's laptop screen glowing brightly, lighting up the dark room].
- Panel 4: Close-up of [Subject smiling with relief, looking at the screen].
- Panel 5: POV shot of [the screen displaying 'Compilation Successful' in green text].
- Panel 6: Medium shot of [Subject raising hands in victory].
Style: Clean graphic novel, dynamic lighting, cinematic framing, highly detailed, consistent art style across all panels, neutral gray panel borders.
